in_arabic.name: مرغوب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مرغوب مشتق از ریشه م-ر-غ-ب، پسندیده شده، مطلوب، محبوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مرغوب از ریشه عربی م-ر-غ-ب مشتق شده است. این نام به معنای پسندیده شده، مطلوب، و محبوب است. در فرهنگ اسلامی، مرغوب به کسی اطلاق می شود که مورد علاقه و رضایت خداوند متعال قرار دارد. این نام نشان دهنده صفات نیکو و پسندیده در فرد است.

in_urdu.name: مرغوب
in_urdu.meaning: مرغوب کا مطلب ہے پسندیدہ، قابل پسند، اور محبوب
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرغوب نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح م-ر-غ-ب سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے پسندیدہ، قابل پسند، اور محبوب۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، یہ نام فرد کی اچھی صفات اور مقبولیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मर्गूब
in_hindi.meaning: मर्गूब का अर्थ है पसंदीदा, प्रियतम, और अत्यंत प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: मर्गूब नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है पसंदीदा, प्रियतम, और अत्यंत प्रिय। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम व्यक्ति की अच्छी विशेषताओं और उच्च आत्मिक मूल्यों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: مرغوب
in_pashto.meaning: مرغوب د معنی دے منلړی، خوښونکی، او محبوب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرغوب نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د منلړی، خوښونکی، او محبوب په معنا دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د نیکو صفاتو او د الهي رضا څخه ګټل شوي کس ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Marghub
in_english.meaning: Marghub means beloved, desirable, and highly esteemed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Marghub originates from the Arabic root 'm-r-gh-b'. It means beloved, desirable, and highly esteemed. In Islamic tradition, Marghub signifies someone who is pleasing to God and possesses noble qualities. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual excellence and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Marghub" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world, where the concept of conquering one's desires, fears, and challenges is deeply ingrained in the Islamic faith. The name suggests strength, determination, and the ability to overcome obstacles, making it a desirable name for individuals seeking to embody these traits. It can also be seen as a reminder of the historical Islamic conquests, highlighting the triumphs of the Islamic civilization and its impact on the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "Marghub" holds spiritual significance as it represents the idea of striving against one's inner weaknesses and vices. It is a reminder of the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), "Indeed, the strong believer is better and more lovable to Allah than the weak believer, even though we may love the weak believer." (Sahih Muslim). The name encourages individuals to strive towards self-improvement and to overcome their spiritual challenges, leading to a deeper connection with Allah. Moreover, the name symbolizes the concept of Al-Qahhar (the All-Powerful) and Al-Jabbar (the Compeller), reminding individuals of Allah's infinite power and ability to overcome any obstacle.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, Volume 13, page 153 The name Marghub carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The title 'Marghub' (conqueror) was first used for Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab by his companions due to the numerous military campaigns he led during his caliphate.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's Ithaf al-Safa wa'l-Targhib fil-Hikam al-Atfal (The Instruction and the Enticement for the Wise Children) Volume 1, page 33
historical_references.context: The title 'Marghub' was also used for Sultan Salah al-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub (Saladin) in recognition of his military victories and successful campaigns.
